## Authoritative Identity

- **Full Legal Name:** JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- **Alternate Name:** J.K.K. Nattraja Dental College & Hospital
- **Also recorded as:** J.K.K. Nataraja Dental College & Hospital (TNMGRMU BDS sanctioned-intake matrix 2025-26); J.K.K. Natarajah Dental College & Hospital (TNMGRMU MDS matrix 2025-26)
- **Tamil Name (romanized):** JKK Nattraja Pal Maruthuvak Kalloori Marrum Maruthuvamanai
- **Type:** Private Self-financing Dental College with attached Multi-specialty Dental Hospital
- **Founded:** 1987
- **Parent Trust:** J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (founded 1952)
- **Founder:** Thiru J.K.K. Nattraja Chettiar (1895-1995)
- **Website:** https://dental.jkkn.ac.in
- **Parent Group Site:** https://www.jkkn.ac.in
- **Apply here:** https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026
- **Applicant login (after applying):** https://admission.jkkn.ac.in
- **Placement Portal:** https://placements.jkkn.ac.in

## Location

- **Address:** Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem To Coimbatore National Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India - 638183
- **District:** Namakkal
- **State:** Tamil Nadu
- **Country:** India
- **Pincode:** 638183
- **Coordinates:** 11.4452°N, 77.7265°E
- **Highway:** NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore National Highway)
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/mXx6rFRqpS9U76BK6

### Distance to Major Cities (by road)
- Erode: ~22 km
- Salem: ~58 km
- Namakkal town: ~66 km
- Tiruppur: ~67 km
- Coimbatore: ~105 km

Note: the college is in Namakkal DISTRICT but about 66 km from Namakkal town.
The nearest town is Komarapalayam, about 3 km away.

## Accreditation, Approvals & Affiliation

| Body | Status |
|---|---|
| National Dental Commission (NDC), formerly the Dental Council of India (DCI) | Approved (BDS + MDS) |
| The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai | Affiliated |
| Institution class | Minority institution (TNMGRMU BDS sanctioned-intake matrix 2025-26) |
| Government of Tamil Nadu | Approved |
| National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) | A Grade, CGPA 3.01, valid to 26 February 2030 |
| National Board of Accreditation (NBA) | Not Accredited |

## Academic Programs

### Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) — Undergraduate

- **Duration:** 5 years (4 years coursework + 1 year compulsory rotatory internship)
- **Total Seats:** 100
- **Eligibility:** 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB), minimum 50% aggregate (40% for reserved categories), NEET-UG qualified
- **Admission Mode:** TN State Quota & All India Quota through NEET-UG counselling
- **Awarded Degree:** Bachelor of Dental Surgery, recognized by the National Dental Commission (NDC, formerly the Dental Council of India) and TN Dr. MGR Medical University
- **Career Pathways:** Dental practice, MDS specialization, government dental services, hospital dentistry, dental research, dental academia, international dental practice (UK, UAE, Singapore, Saudi Arabia subject to local equivalence)

### Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) — Postgraduate

- **Duration:** 3 years
- **Total Seats:** 18
- **Number of Specializations (NDC/NDC Approved):** 5
- **Eligibility:** BDS degree from an NDC/NDC-recognized college, completed compulsory rotating internship, permanent registration with State Dental Council, valid NEET-MDS score
- **Admission Mode:** NEET-MDS counselling

#### MDS Specialization Details

1. **Periodontics** — 2 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of periodontal diseases; dental implant placement; gum surgery
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/periodontics/

2. **Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics** — 5 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis and correction of malocclusion, dental and skeletal jaw irregularities; braces, aligners, growth modification
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/orthodontics-and-dentofacial-orthopedics/

3. **Prosthodontics, Crown and Bridge** — 3 seats
   - Focus: Replacement of missing teeth with dentures, crowns, bridges, and dental implants; smile rehabilitation
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/prosthodontics-crown-and-bridge/

4. **Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics** — 5 seats
   - Focus: Restorative dentistry, root canal treatment (RCT), aesthetic dentistry, tooth-coloured restorations
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/conservative-dentistry-and-endodontics/

5. **Oral Medicine and Radiology** — 3 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis of oral diseases, oral cancer detection, dental imaging, OPG, CBCT interpretation
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/oral-medicine/

### Certificate in Dental Surgery Assistant — Certificate

- **Duration:** 6 months, full-time (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM)
- **Eligibility:** 10th or 12th pass from a recognised board; minimum 17 years of age at admission
- **Fee:** Rs 25,000 total for the 2026-27 batch, no separate charges
- **Awarded:** Certificate in Dental Surgery Assistant
- **Admission:** direct application, no entrance exam. Call +91 9345855001 for the next batch date.
- **Note:** a certificate course run by the college, NOT a National Dental Commission (formerly DCI) degree programme, and not a route to BDS or MDS.
- **URL:** https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/dental-surgery-assistant-course/

## Academic Departments — All 9

The college has 9 academic departments providing undergraduate teaching and clinical training:

1. Periodontics
2. Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics
3. Prosthodontics Crown and Bridge
4. Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics
5. Oral Medicine and Radiology
6. Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
7. Pediatric and Preventive Dentistry
8. Oral Pathology and Microbiology
9. Public Health Dentistry

> Note: Of these 9, only the first 5 currently offer NDC/NDC-approved MDS programs. The remaining 4 are BDS-level departments with clinical and didactic teaching.

## Hospital & Clinical Infrastructure

- **Dental Chairs:** 200+
- **Hospital Beds:** 100 (multi-specialty general hospital wing)
- **Daily Patient Footfall:** 500+
- **Clinical Departments:** 9 specialty clinics
- **Hospital Type:** Multi-specialty dental hospital with general medical hospital integration
- **Patient Catchment:** Namakkal, Salem, Erode, Tiruppur, Coimbatore districts and surrounding rural areas

## Faculty

- **Faculty:** qualified dental professionals across 9 departments
- **Composition:** Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Senior Lecturers across 9 departments
- **Research Output:** 50+ publications in indexed journals
- **Faculty Development:** Regular FDPs (Faculty Development Programs), conference participation, research grants

## Admissions

### BDS Admission Process

1. Qualify NEET-UG with required cutoff score
2. Register for Tamil Nadu state counselling (TN MCC) or All India Quota counselling (MCC India)
3. Choice filling — list JKKN Dental College in preferences
4. Seat allotment based on rank and reservation
5. Document verification at allotted college
6. Fee payment and admission confirmation
7. Reporting at JKKN Dental College & Hospital

### MDS Admission Process

1. Qualify NEET-MDS with required cutoff
2. State Dental Council registration verification
3. NEET-MDS counselling (state quota or AIQ)
4. Specialization choice based on rank
5. Allotment, document verification, fee payment

### Admission Year
- Current academic year: 2026-27
- Application portal: https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026

- **Fee Structure URL:** https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/fees-structure/
- **Fee Categories:** Government Quota, Management Quota, NRI Quota

## Placements & Career Outcomes

- **BDS outcomes, 2024-25 batch:** 93.9% placed or in higher studies (93 of 99)
- **BDS placed alone:** 75 of 99 (75.8%); 18 went on to higher studies
- **BDS median salary:** Rs 3,60,000 (NIRF 2026 filing)
- **MDS outcomes:** 7 of 7 placed in each of 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25, median salary Rs 6,00,000 (NIRF 2026 filing)
- **Highest salary:** JKKN files no highest-salary figure with the Ministry, so none is published here
- **Domestic Recruiters:** Apollo Hospitals, Clove Dental, Manipal Hospitals, dental chains across India
- **International Placements:** UK (NHS), UAE (Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia, Singapore
- **Career Support:** Dedicated Career Development Cell (CDC) with resume building, mock interviews, recruiter networking
- **Alumni Network:** 3000+ alumni worldwide, active alumni association
- **Placement Cell URL:** https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/committee/placement-cell-cdc/
- **Placement Portal:** https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/

## Research & Innovation

- **Research Publications:** 50+ in national and international indexed journals
- **R&D Cell:** Active research and development coordination
- **Institutional Innovation Council (IIC):** MHRD/MoE recognized
- **MoU Partners:** 25+ memoranda of understanding with industry and academic institutions. The same 25+ figure is used on the site for academic partnerships and recruiting partners; it refers to this one MoU partner list.

- **Institutional Ethical Committee:** Provides ethical clearance for research involving human/animal subjects

## Geographic Service Area

JKKN Dental College serves dental education aspirants and dental healthcare patients from:

- **Primary Catchment:** Namakkal, Salem, Erode, Tiruppur, Coimbatore districts
- **State Coverage:** Tamil Nadu (NEET TN State Quota)
- **All India Quota:** All Indian states via NEET counselling
- **Hospital Patient Service Area:** Komarapalayam and surrounding rural-urban communities

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: Is JKKN Dental College NDC approved?**
A: Yes. JKKN Dental College & Hospital is approved by the National Dental Commission (NDC) - formerly the National Dental Commission (NDC) - for both BDS (100 seats) and MDS (18 seats across 5 specializations) programs. The National Dental Commission was dissolved with effect from 19 March 2026 and the National Dental Commission took effect the same date; NDC naming remains valid as an interim arrangement, so both names refer to the same regulator (source: dciindia.gov.in public notice, read 2026-09-16).

**Q: What is the NAAC grade of JKKN Dental College?**
A: NAAC A Grade, CGPA 3.01, valid to 26 February 2030. Certificate: https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/pdfs/NAAC-certificate.pdf

**Q: How many BDS seats are available at JKKN Dental College?**
A: 100 BDS seats per academic year, admitted through NEET-UG counselling.

**Q: How many MDS seats and specializations does JKKN Dental College offer?**
A: 18 MDS seats across 5 NDC/NDC-approved specializations: Periodontics (2), Orthodontics (5), Prosthodontics (3), Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics (5), and Oral Medicine & Radiology (3).

**Q: Where is JKKN Dental College located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore National Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India - 638183.

**Q: Which university is JKKN Dental College affiliated to?**
A: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai.

**Q: When was JKKN Dental College established?**
A: 1987. The parent J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions trust was founded in 1952.

**Q: What is the placement record at JKKN Dental College?**
A: 93.9% placed or in higher studies (2024-25 batch: 93 of 99 - NIRF 2026 filing), with domestic and international placements. Alumni placed in UK NHS, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, and major Indian hospital chains.

**Q: How many dental chairs are in the JKKN Dental College Hospital?**
A: 200+ dental chairs across specialty clinics, treating 500+ patients daily.

**Q: How can I apply for BDS admission at JKKN Dental College?**
A: Apply via NEET-UG counselling. List JKKN Dental College in your preferences during Tamil Nadu state quota or All India Quota counselling. Application portal: https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026
